# Lob

> > Lob is a direct mail automation platform offering digital-first direct mail solutions through its Print Delivery Network and Postal IQ routing technology.

Lob enables businesses to automate direct mail campaigns at scale, combining traditional direct mail marketing with modern API-driven workflows. The platform provides tools for creating, managing, and optimizing direct mail campaigns with features like intelligent routing and sustainability tracking.

## Key Topics

- Direct Mail Automation
- Print Delivery Network
- Postal IQ Routing
- Direct Mail Marketing
- Mail API
- Sustainability
- Consumer Insights
- Best Practices
- Campaign Optimization
- Digital-First Direct Mail
- Print Network
- Marketing Automation
